observations: Augment terminals let players switch declared encounter roles across the raid.
The first prolonged encounter combines enemy pressure, observation, coordination, and a security puzzle while previewing rules used later.
Shared spaces split the fireteam and force communication strategy.
Raid rewards are distributed across weapon slots and are intended to include items useful inside the raid.
inferences: Boss difficulty can come from role and information coordination rather than boss durability.
An early encounter can teach a mechanical language that later encounters recombine under pressure.
limits: Bungie's retrospective emphasizes intended structure and selected outcomes.
Six-player coordination cannot be assumed to transfer unchanged to solo combat.
